name: Warm Steak, Broccoli & Bell Pepper Salad with Sesame Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into thin strips.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper and broccoli; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pat the steak dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies have softened, add steak and stir-fry sauce to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and steak is cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place water, additional stir-fry sauce, oil, and sesame seeds in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup water
⅓ cup stir-fry sauce
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, divide dressed greens between plates or bowls; top with warm steak and veggies. Enjoy!
